This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, recorded simply as Digital Realty in Dallas County, TX, could not be confidently matched to a specific building this session. The operators own Dallas portfolio page, fetched fresh this session, lists 12 separate facilities, and this rows coordinates place it within a cluster of Richardson, TX buildings on or near Alma Road, Integrity Drive, Collins Boulevard, and Security Row, specifically candidates DFW16 at 1232 Alma Road, DFW17 at 900 Quality Way, DFW18 at 1210 Integrity Drive, DFW25 at 1215 Integrity Drive, DFW28 at 850 E. Collins Boulevard, DFW29 at 950 E. Collins Boulevard, and DFW35 at 907 Security Row, all within about a mile of each other and all in Richardson, which sits mostly within Dallas County. With seven plausible candidates this close together and no precise geocoding tool available this session, and this rows own name carrying no building code to narrow the field, no specific address is asserted for this row.
